name: Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balanceL!_eq_balance!
typeText:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : α → Type v} {k : α} {v : β k} {l r : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.{u, v} α β},
  Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Balanced.{u, v} l →
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Balanced.{u, v} r →
      Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.BalanceLErasePrecond (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.size.{u, v} l)
          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.size.{u, v} r) →
        Eq.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balanceL!.{u, v} k v l r)
          (Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balance!.{u, v} k v l r)

source.code:
theorem balanceL!_eq_balance! {k : α} {v : β k} {l r : Impl α β} (hlb : l.Balanced)
    (hrb : r.Balanced) (hlr : BalanceLErasePrecond l.size r.size) :
    balanceL! k v l r = balance! k v l r := by
  fun_cases balance!
  all_goals dsimp only [balanceL!]
  all_goals try simp only [*]
  all_goals try rfl
  all_goals try (exfalso; tree_tac; done)
  congr; tree_tac
